planning_note: Top-level integration module; structure decomposes into declarations, sub-module instances, combinational glue (status registers, master Wishbone mux), interrupt generation, and clock/reset handling.

structural_blocks.purpose: Declare all internal wires and regs used to interconnect sub-modules, carry status/control between them, and hold muxed master Wishbone outputs.
must_appear: All signals required to connect sub-modules as per spec.
may_appear: Temporary signals for status bit manipulations.

structural_blocks.purpose: Instantiate all child modules: sd_controller_wb, sd_clock_divider, sd_cmd_master, sd_cmd_serial_host, sd_data_master, sd_data_serial_host, tx_bd (sd_bd), rx_bd (sd_bd), sd_fifo_tx_filler, sd_fifo_rx_filler.
must_appear: All sub-modules as listed in the spec (section 3.2) and child_modules.

structural_blocks.purpose: Combinational logic to assemble internal status registers that are forwarded to sd_controller_wb: Bd_status_reg, status_reg[0], status_reg[1], status_reg[15:2], normal_int_status_reg, error_int_status_reg, Bd_isr_reg per spec datapath_contract.
must_appear: Exact mappings as described in datapath_contract and spec’s Register Update table.

structural_blocks.purpose: Multiplex master Wishbone interface signals (m_wb_adr_o, m_wb_dat_o, m_wb_cyc_o, m_wb_stb_o, m_wb_cti_o, m_wb_bte_o, m_wb_we_o) based on start_tx_fifo and start_rx_fifo. When start_tx_fifo is high, connect to sd_fifo_tx_filler; when start_rx_fifo is high, connect to sd_fifo_rx_filler; else zero.
must_appear: All master WB signals covered by muxing (m_wb_adr_o, m_wb_dat_o, m_wb_cyc_o, m_wb_stb_o, m_wb_cti_o, m_wb_bte_o, m_wb_we_o). m_wb_sel_o may be constant 4’b1111.
may_appear: Constant assignment for m_wb_sel_o if fixed.

structural_blocks.purpose: Generate combinational interrupt outputs int_a, int_b, int_c according to spec: int_a = OR of (normal_int_status_reg & normal_int_signal_enable_reg); int_b = OR of (error_int_status_reg & error_int_signal_enable_reg); int_c = OR of (Bd_isr_reg & Bd_isr_enable_reg). These signals are optionally enabled by SDC_IRQ_ENABLE, else tied low.

Handle generation of sd_clk_o and mapping of resets. Select sd_clk_o source based on defines (SDC_CLK_BUS_CLK, SDC_CLK_DYNAMIC). Tie sd_clk_o_pad to sd_clk_o. Combine wb_rst_i and software_reset_reg[0] to generate an internal reset for sub-modules; also incorporate go_idle_o for sd_cmd_serial_host reset.
must_appear: Clock selection based on define semantics, reset combination.

semantic_modes.meaning: all sub-modules active; Wishbone slave and master operate; commands and data transfers proceed as controlled by sd_cmd_master and sd_data_master.

state_model.notes: All state is contained within sub-modules; sdc_controller is purely combinational/instantiation glue with control signals from sub-modules.

global_invariants: Master Wishbone outputs driven only by acknowledged DMA filler (or zero) – never simultaneous.
Interrupts reflect pending conditions only when enabled.
Status register assembly is purely combinational and reflects current sub-module outputs.
open_semantic_questions: Precise timing of internal reset de-assertion relative to wb_rst_i and software_reset_reg[0].
Interrupt sensitivity (combinational, not latching) – potential for multiple triggers per status change.

responsibilities: Provide all interconnect wires/regs needed by B2..B6.
timing_semantics: Combinational wiring; no storage in this block.
coupling_rules: All other blocks rely on B1 as name source.
forbidden_drift: Do not introduce registered objects not justified by spec.

responsibilities: Instantiate and connect all child modules exactly as per architectural spec.
timing_semantics: Sub-module clocking and resets as per their contracts; sdc_controller distributes appropriate clocks/resets.
coupling_rules: Wiring must match the port lists defined in the spec; no missing connections.
forbidden_drift: Do not instance additional modules beyond those listed in spec.

responsibilities: Combinational assembly of status registers that sd_controller_wb expects.
timing_semantics: Purely combinational; outputs change within same wb_clk_i cycle as inputs.
touched_objects: free_rx_bd, free_tx_bd, STATUS_REG, cmd_int_busy, cidat_w, NORMAL_INT_REG, ERR_INT_REG, Dat_Int_Status.
coupling_rules: Outputs feed directly into sd_controller_wb ports.
forbidden_drift: Do not pipeline or register these status values unless spec requires it (spec is explicit about combinational).

responsibilities: Multiplex master Wishbone outputs based on start_tx_fifo/start_rx_fifo.
timing_semantics: Purely combinational; mux output selected immediately.
touched_objects: tx_filler Wishbone signals, rx_filler Wishbone signals, final m_wb_* outputs.
coupling_rules: Must never drive when both start signals are low (outputs zero).
forbidden_drift: Do not add internal latches or state.

responsibilities: Derive interrupt outputs from status/enable register pairs.
timing_semantics: Combinational; int_x changes as soon as source registers change.
touched_objects: normal_int_status_reg, normal_int_signal_enable_reg, error_int_status_reg, error_int_signal_enable_reg, Bd_isr_reg, Bd_isr_enable_reg.
coupling_rules: Gated by SDC_IRQ_ENABLE define; otherwise forced low.
forbidden_drift: Do not add edge-triggered or latched behavior.

responsibilities: Select sd_clk_o source and produce internal resets for sub-modules.
coupling_rules: go_idle_o from sd_cmd_master only affects sd_cmd_serial_host reset.
forbidden_drift: Do not create additional clock domains.

chosen_decisions.decision: Decompose into six functional blocks: declarations, sub-module instances, status assembly, master WB mux, interrupt generation, clock/reset mux.
chosen_decisions.reason: Aligns with spec responsibilities and aids retrieval/merge; each block addresses a distinct integration concern.

deferred_decisions: Exact ordering or grouping of constant assignments (e.g., m_wb_sel_o) – can be in B1 or B4; will be resolved during code generation.
Synthesis-friendly handling of conditional compilation defines; skeleton only marks placeholders.
structural_risks: If sub-module port names mismatch exactly with skeleton placeholders, B2 may need adjustment after instantiation code is generated from sub-module contracts.
behavioral_risks: Combinational interrupt generation may cause glitches on int_a/b/c when status registers change; specification does not mandate edge‑detection or synchronization; potential risk if hardware expects stable interrupts.
